parameters.content:
Shared human approval resume v1.0.0

Resumes an approval-required agent action only after GuardianHub confirms the approval is valid and non-expired. The approval check is enforced server-side; this workflow runs the post-approval action.

parameters.jsCode: const crypto=require('crypto');const s=$env.N8N_CALLBACK_SIGNING_SECRET||$env.N8N_GUARDIANHUB_SIGNING_SECRET;const b=$json.body||'';if(b.approval_status!=='approved')throw new Error('Approval not confirmed');const cb={run_id:b.run_id||'',agent_key:b.agent_key,company_id:b.company_id,event_type:b.event_type,status:'succeeded',result:{agent:b.agent_key,message:'Post-approval action completed',processed_at:new Date().toISOString()}};const sig=s?crypto.createHmac('sha256',s).update(JSON.stringify(cb)).digest('hex'):'';return[{json:{callback:cb,signature:sig,timestamp:String(Date.now()),nonce:$json.headers['x-gh-nonce']||'',correlation_id:$json.headers['x-gh-correlation-id']||''}}];
